claims.claim: Sharp AR-M201 All-in-One Digital Copier for sale.
claims.evidence: The photos show “SHARP” (photo 1) but the specific model “AR-M201” is not readable/confirmed on the machine in photos 0–2.

claims.claim: Fairly used, fully functional, and ready to...
claims.evidence: Photos only show the machine powered/open; there is no proof of a successful print/copy test, no error display, and no close-up of status/serial/model label (photos 0–2).

risks.risk: Model mismatch: the unit may not be AR-M201, which changes parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label (usually on the side/back or inside the cover) showing “AR-M201” and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Sharp used all-in-one copier/printer with unknown model and unknown consumable/parts condition.

risks.risk: Not truly functional (paper feed, scanning, fuser/laser, or error codes).
risks.proof: A short video or photo sequence showing a completed copy/print job (e.g., “Copy” start → output page finishing) with no error message.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/assume worst case: needs service or at least not guaranteed to print/copy reliably.

risks.risk: Consumables/maintenance items may be near end-of-life (toner/drum/transfer belt/fuser), causing immediate extra cost.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of toner/drum/maintenance indicators or a service/usage counter screen (and any “replace” warnings).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming consumables may be low/aged and may require replacement soon.

risks.risk: Physical issues not visible: glass/rollers, internal damage, or misalignment.
risks.proof: Photos of the paper tray area, inside paper path, and rollers (both sides) plus a test page showing alignment/ghosting.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible minor wear and potential alignment/quality issues.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables (power cord, USB/network, original document feeder parts).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included: power cable, any network/USB cable, and whether an ADF/document feeder is present and working.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming buyer may need to source missing accessories.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial label confirming “AR-M201” (and serial number).
A completed copy/print test (video or photos showing the machine producing a page with no error).
Close-up of the control panel status screen showing readiness and any warnings/counters.
Photos of the inside paper path/rollers and the paper tray area.
Photo of included accessories (power cable, any interface cables, and whether ADF is present).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Sharp all-in-one copier/printer, but the exact model “AR-M201” and the “fully functional” claim are not verifiable from the provided images. A test print/copy and a readable model/serial label are needed before pricing confidently.
